Meet The Beekeeper's Café

A Cause for Celebration

The Beekeeper's Café is a Victorian-themed coffee haven in downtown Pottstown. Founded in Kenilworth in 2022 and relocated to Pottstown in 2025, the café serves farm-direct freshly roasted coffee and locally baked treats, with free Wi-Fi, live music, and a parking lot.

The menu includes signature drinks like the Bumble Fizz and the lavender latte, plus hand pies, scones, and blueberry cake donuts. The honey motif runs throughout, with honey-sweetened drinks, and honey jars and handmade soaps sold in-store.
